comparison: COCOA-PAD supplies a preparation-specific controlled walking positive primarily 2.5 hours after the last beverage, with pilot threshold, timing, missingness and observed harms limits. COSMOS supplies overall functional nulls for a different capsule preparation in a different population, with retained tandem-stand and opposing subgroup signals. Neither result is assigned to isolated ingredients or generic cocoa, and the effects are not pooled.
identity_policy: The sole descriptive aliases identify the tested study preparations. They do not establish current retail identity, full composition, equivalence to chocolate or all cocoa/flavanols, or isolated epicatechin efficacy. No source catalogue match or absence is inferred by this qualification.

preparation.source_dose_interpretation: Daily totals reported in the original abstract, not per beverage; study description only.
preparation.administration: Powder packets mixed with water or milk in main; protocol describes water.
preparation.placebo: Hershey-manufactured cocoa-free/flavanol-free beverage, similar appearing and tasting, identically packaged with masked group labels.
preparation.protocol_energy_description: Approximately 180 calories daily in each group; nearly identical nutritional content.
preparation.full_composition_status: Online Table I was inaccessible. Exact complete macro/micronutrient, total-flavanol, caffeine and theobromine content, lot/COA and current retail equivalence remain unverified.

alias_scope.reason: A study preparation label does not identify all cocoa products, isolated ingredients or a presently marketed product.

design.type: Single-center parallel randomized masked pilot trial
design.population: Adults at least 60 years old with PAD; important mobility/comorbidity and procedure exclusions.
design.randomization: Permuted blocks stratified by baseline six-minute walk. Protocol v15 specifies blocks of four and six and computerized assignment.
design.masking: Main: participants, investigators, study staff and data management masked to A/B identities until end. Current registry: quadruple masking. Protocol uses D/F packet labels.
design.source_strata_typo: Main gives 365.75 m versus 367.65 m at the split around 1200 feet; exact cutpoint wording is inconsistent and not silently repaired.
design.generalizability: PAD walking limitations do not directly model inherited muscle disease, pediatric MVA or BUB1B variants.

endpoint_measurement.walking: Six-minute corridor walk on a 100-foot course; instruction to cover as much distance as possible. Integrated mobility, not isolated muscle-force measurement.
endpoint_measurement.two_primary_assessments: Six-month change measured 2.5 h and 24 h after beverage.
endpoint_measurement.secondary_treadmill: Gardner-Skinner pain-free and maximal walking times at 48 h after beverage.
endpoint_measurement.dose_timing: Study beverage temporarily stopped for timed outcomes and resumed for biopsy/perfusion; most remaining outcomes obtained on continuing beverage.
endpoint_measurement.durability_limit: 2.5 h combines chronic exposure with recent intake; timing arms do not isolate acute/chronic components or prove their interaction. The 24 h main analysis and 48 h treadmill nulls limit a durable withdrawal claim.
endpoint_measurement.learning_fatigue: Consecutive 2.5 h/24 h tests and different placebo responses permit learning/fatigue explanations, not established causal accounts.

functional_results.source: PMID 32078436, PMC author manuscript Tables 3 and 4
functional_results.dispersion: Baseline and follow-up SD; within-group finite 90% CIs and between-group one-sided 90% CIs copied as reported. No CIs recalculated.
functional_results.nonadditivity: Raw baseline/follow-up means do not subtract to the adjusted within-group changes; the source footnotes explicitly attribute this to adjustment.

results.analysis: Main Table 3 observed outcomes; labelled intention to treat
Main Table 3 observed outcomes; labelled intention to treat

Main Table 3 multiple imputation for missing surviving participants

additional_reported_sensitivities.analysis: Exclude two cocoa participants revascularized during follow-up
Exclude two cocoa participants revascularized during follow-up

functional_results.sensitivity_denominators: Not supplied in this main-results prose; no reconstructed n assigned.

missingness.endpoint_n: Table 3 observed 17/20 and 19/20; imputed survivors 22/21. Do not substitute randomized or any-follow-up counts.
missingness.imputation: 20 multiple imputations for missing survivors. One death excluded. Variables/model/seed and individual records not supplied sufficiently to reproduce.
missingness.ITT_label_limit: Assigned groups retained regardless of adherence, but observed-outcome analyses contain fewer than 44 and imputation covers 43 survivors.
missingness.registry_denominator_difference: Registry primary family uses 19/21 and treadmill family 18/19, while the main supplies timepoint-specific 17/20,19/20 and maximal treadmill 18/20. Main endpoint-specific values are retained.

statistics_and_prespecification.reported_rule: One-sided P<.10; between-arm one-sided 90% confidence intervals.
statistics_and_prespecification.main_power: 70% power for roughly 30 m difference, using SD 52 m and 20 participants per arm at one-sided .10.
statistics_and_prespecification.protocol_amendment: Section 11.3 says one-sided .10 and one-sided 90% CIs were selected after recruitment completed and before reviewing results. Native page 22 verified. Earlier sections retain two-sided 95% CIs and interval-precision calculations.
statistics_and_prespecification.multiplicity: Two primary timings and numerous secondary/exploratory outcomes; no family-wise correction or prespecified multiplicity hierarchy established. Treat P values as nominal pilot analyses.
statistics_and_prespecification.planned_missingness: v15 discusses expected low missingness and an adherence-subset sensitivity restricted to at least 80%; does not document the final multiple-imputation procedure.
statistics_and_prespecification.24h_robustness: Observed analysis P=.12 and adherence adjustment P=.114; imputation P=.084 and revascularization exclusion P=.058 cross only the pilot .10 threshold.
statistics_and_prespecification.hierarchy_and_reporting_difference: Protocol v15 lists perfusion and regeneration measures among secondary aims; main calls these exploratory. Planned TFAM is not reported in the reviewed main. This is a recorded document difference, not proof of selective reporting.

registry.interpretation: Registration predates trial start according to current metadata, but original endpoint wording and amendment history were not retrieved. Primary-completion date differs from final clinical follow-up in article; later laboratory work occurred, but the registry date rationale was not verified.
registry.IPD_sharing: Current record says NO; main says supporting data available upon reasonable request.

muscle_biology.selection: Optional biopsy subset, not all randomized participants. Biochemical assays generally 10/6; histology 11/6.

COX.interpretation: Relative contrast largely from greater placebo decline, not an observed within-cocoa enzyme increase; baseline values differ substantially.

capillary_density.measurement: Lectin-positive capillaries relative to fiber number in methods.

central_nuclei.interpretation: Relative reduction versus placebo increase, not a demonstrated within-cocoa reduction or renewal-fidelity assay.

perfusion.analysis: Log-transformed data per Table 5 footnote; retain reported scale, do not reinterpret as an untransformed absolute flow gain.

muscle_biology.native_figure2: Same tissue sample before/after lamin A/C staining; nuclear envelope surrounds DAPI signal, supporting central-nucleus identity. Not a treatment before/after panel.
muscle_biology.mediation_and_fidelity: Concurrent randomized-subset biochemical/histological differences do not demonstrate mediation of walking, purified epicatechin causality, satellite-cell self-renewal, chromosome fidelity, BUBR1 or MVA rescue.

harms_and_support.attribution: Main states no serious event considered likely related to study participation. Do not upgrade this to proof of unrelatedness or safety.
harms_and_support.adjudication_limit: Protocol plans blinded DSMB review at least six-monthly and continuous AE monitoring; case-level adjudication records/DSMB minutes not obtained.
harms_and_support.nonserious_event_limit: Registry explicitly says information about other adverse events was not collected; zero/zero other-event fields are not evidence of absence. Native flow records four cocoa discontinuations for side effects.
harms_and_support.smoking_explanation: Authors hypothesize higher cocoa-arm smoking could contribute; this is not demonstrated causation.

publication_status.result: No matching correction/retraction notice was exposed by retained PubMed/Crossref metadata or these bounded searches. The linked PMID 32078440 is an editorial CommentIn, not a correction. This is not a comprehensive publication-integrity audit.
source_version_discrepancies: Author-manuscript abstract states central-nuclei P=.024, whereas its Table 5 and the final PubMed abstract state .033. Use the actual Table 5 result and retain the discrepancy.
Author-manuscript randomization text gives baseline-walk cutpoints 365.75 and 367.65 metres; no silent harmonization of the printed mismatch.

cocoa-pad.conclusion: Retain a preparation-specific controlled mobility-compensation challenger. The direct 2.5 h walking contrast merits consideration under the same endpoint and access standards as provisional nominees; pilot amendment, multiple outcomes, missingness, 24 h sensitivity and 48 h nulls, preparation limits and observed harms prevent definitive efficacy/safety or broad ingredient claims. No nomination replacement or MVA benefit established.

study.title: Effects of cocoa extract supplementation on physical performance measures: results from the randomized controlled COcoa Supplement and Multivitamin Outcomes study
study.version_notice_limit: Corrected-typeset is a production date, not a formal correction notice. No linked correction/retraction exposed by retained Crossref/XML metadata; no exhaustive notice search.

preparation.separate_factor: Centrum Silver multivitamin/multimineral versus its placebo; supplied by Pfizer Consumer Healthcare, now Haleon
preparation.attribution_limit: Whole-extract result; no isolated epicatechin, arbitrary cocoa product, chocolate, or food-equivalence credit.

design.type: Double-blind placebo-controlled 2 × 2 factorial parent RCT, with clinic functional subset
design.randomization: Computer-generated permuted blocks; parent report describes stratification by sex, age and recruitment source, blocks of 12, and household members assigned together where possible
design.attrition_limit: Native supplementary flowchart does not supply arm-specific losses or reasons; task counts are pooled observations at each visit, not necessarily complete-pair analysis counts.
design.run_in: Two-month placebo run-in, at least 75% self-reported pill adherence required
design.population: Generally healthy ambulatory parent-trial participants within 50 miles of Boston; women aged at least 65 and men at least 60
design.low_function_prevalence: Low grip 6.5% of men and 8.1% of women; SPPB ≤8 in 2.1%; only one TUG >20 seconds; no gait ≤0.8 m/s or chair stands >15 seconds
design.nonstudy_supplements: Personal cocoa extract and MVM supplements prohibited
design.analysis_estimand: Cocoa versus cocoa placebo, averaged across MVM assignment; repeated-measures treatment × time contrast adjusted for age, sex and MVM assignment
design.missingness: All available data; missing-at-random assumption; no participant-level reanalysis

secondary_list: normal walking speed, also under primary walking-speed language
hierarchy_registration.unresolved_normal_speed_hierarchy: Normal walking speed appears both under primary walking-speed language and in the secondary list.
current_registry_endpoints: Injurious falls resulting in healthcare utilization
hierarchy_registration.temporal_limit: Current registry and 2023 published design follow the completed 2020 functional data collection. They support reported aims but do not independently verify prospective registration of the functional hierarchy. No historical registry versions or pre-unblinding protocol/SAP were read.
hierarchy_registration.design_report: PMID36621596 / PMC10732156 / DOI10.1016/j.cct.2023.107078; selected aims, physical-assessment, analysis-plan and power sections read
hierarchy_registration.analysis_plan_difference: Published design named recruitment-source and key-baseline-imbalance adjustment; final report names age, sex and MVM. Effect of this difference is unknown.
hierarchy_registration.multiplicity: P<.05; source explicitly states no adjustment for multiple hypotheses. Nominal findings are not automatically spurious.
hierarchy_registration.power_limit: Reported prospective/post hoc detectable differences are not equivalence margins.

main_functional_results.hierarchy: walking speed designated primary; normal speed also listed as secondary

functional_methods.grip: Dominant-hand JAMAR Plus+ digital dynamometer; twice at each visit, mean used
functional_methods.gait: Normal and fast pace over timed 6 m within a 7 m course with rolling start; twice, mean used
functional_methods.sppb: 0–12 points combining gait, five chair stands, and balance
functional_methods.tug: Rise from chair, walk 3 m, turn, return and sit; twice, mean used
functional_methods.balance: Side-by-side, semi-tandem and tandem up to 10 seconds each; assessed once

Grip by at least two prior-year falls

Significant within-subgroup treatment contrast does not establish differential response to MVM assignment.

interpretive_limits.overall: No demonstrated overall cocoa benefit on functional primary outcomes; no equivalence inference.
interpretive_limits.calibration: Authors acknowledge possible equipment calibration issue between baseline and year two. Absolute grip trajectory and measurement validity are uncertain. Comparable equipment/protocol across randomized groups was reported; randomization contrast is not presumed wholly invalid. Calibration records unavailable.
interpretive_limits.exposure: Urinary gVLM treatment difference P<.001 supports differential exposure, not functional efficacy.
interpretive_limits.subgroup_n: Table subgroup Ns are baseline group labels, not verified endpoint-completer denominators.
interpretive_limits.source_sign_inconsistency: Main Table 3 high-baseline-gVLM cocoa grip change prints +10.35 (SE .57) versus placebo −9.38 (.55), treatment P=.22. Sign unresolved, not silently corrected or used as positive efficacy evidence.
interpretive_limits.safety_citation_inconsistency: Functional report cites ref30 for parent adverse effects, but ref30 is a Jamar dynamometer article; parent primary safety text was checked directly.
interpretive_limits.raw_data: Data/code available upon approved request; no raw participant data or calibration records accessed.
inferences_not_supported: Equivalence or proof of no meaningful effect

mvm_context.overall_functional_results: No demonstrated overall MVM benefit; Main supplemental Table 2/3 and all S4 subgroup rows read. This is a separate factor in the same cohort, not biological replication.

harms.clinic_subset_counts: Not supplied in inspected functional main/supplement

shared_limits: No pooled effect, dose threshold, potency comparison or product interchangeability.
COCOA-PAD discovery and source qualification describe one cohort; COSMOS functional/MVM/parent reports are overlapping parent-cohort evidence, not independent replications.
Function, biochemical/histological associations, durable benefit, safety, renewal and chromosome fidelity remain separate claims.
No BUBR1 restoration, actual-BUB1B-allele rescue, MVA benefit or superiority over provisional nominees is established.
No human regimen recommendation or nomination replacement follows.
synthesis_reading_scope: Assembly from the two frozen qualifications, their actual independent review and root comparison notes. No new original-source, native-pixel, registry-history, publication-status or participant-data reading credit is added.
